items.title: Floating Post Tabs
items.subtitle: Keep up to five posts open as draggable bubbles and jump back to exactly where you left off.

items.title: Feed Shortcuts & Sections
items.subtitle: Restyle the feed shortcuts, give followed users their own section, reorder sections, and keep favorites per account.

items.title: Tab Bar Hide Styles
items.subtitle: Hide the tab bar with Left, Right, Fade, or Down, and bring back Apollo's classic one-gesture scroll behavior.

items.title: Tidier Glass Navigation
items.subtitle: Actions collapse into one pill so titles stay centered, with brighter, easier-to-read moderator controls.

items.title: Native Glass Search
items.subtitle: The feed search bar is now the real Liquid Glass pill: it activates in place and tucks away as you scroll.

items.title: Smarter Highlights
items.subtitle: Unread dots, New badges, and +N counts show which Community Highlights you haven't read or that picked up comments.

items.title: Widgets for Any Feed
items.subtitle: Point the Feed and Post widgets at Home, Popular, All, several subreddits, or a multireddit.

items.title: Stability & Fixes
items.subtitle: Fixes for freezes, GIF memory crashes, launch crashes, duplicate saved items, and translation going quiet.
